national_raw_news.title: PM Modi flags off Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express, inaugurates & lays found...
national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi today flagged off the Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express from Bengaluru. The new train service is aimed at providing faster rail connectivity between Bengaluru, Coastal Karnataka and Goa. It will connect key destinations from Hassan and Sakleshpur to Mangaluru, Udupi, Gokarna and Karwar, before reaching Madgaon in Goa, making travel easier and giving tourism a boost. Speaking on the occasion, Satish Kumar, Chairman and CEO of the Railway Board said “The Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express is not just about a non-stop journey but also about offering a picturesque and unforgettable travel experience. The train is set to boost tourism while significantly benefiting passengers,” Prime Minister Narendra Modi also launched a series of development projects worth over 15,600 crore rupees in Karnataka, covering metro connectivity, railways, renewable energy, power transmission and petroleum infrastructure. Addressing a major infrastructure milestone, the Prime Minister inaugurated the 7.5-kilometre Bengaluru Metro Pink Line stretch between Kalena Agrahara and Tavarekere, covering six stations. With this, Bengaluru’s operational metro network has crossed the 100-kilometre mark. The new stretch is expected to improve urban connectivity and ease traffic congestion. The Prime Minister also travelled on the new Metro line. India’s operational metro network has expanded to over 1,200 kilometres across 26 cities from 248 kilometres in five cities in 2014, with nearly 1,000 kilometres of additional lines under construction. In the railway sector, Mr Modi inaugurated four redeveloped stations under the Amrit Bharat Station scheme at Chamarajanagar, Chikkamagaluru, Sakleshpur and Subramanya Road. He also dedicated the 45-kilometre Bagalkot-Wandal railway doubling section and the electrified 55-kilometre Sakleshpur-Subramanya Ghat section to the nation. The Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express was also flagged off, strengthening connectivity between Bengaluru, coastal Karnataka and Goa. In the energy sector, the Prime Minister dedicated an 80,000-metric-tonne underground LPG storage cavern in Mangaluru, said to be the largest of its kind in the country. He also dedicated the Devangonthi marketing terminal of MRPL and laid the foundation stone for a compressed biogas plant at Haralur Kunte, which will process 300 tonnes of municipal waste daily. Several major renewable energy transmission projects were also inaugurated, while foundation stones were laid for additional power transmission schemes to strengthen Karnataka’s renewable energy infrastructure. The projects are expected to give a major boost to Karnataka’s urban mobility, railway connectivity, energy security and scientific infrastructure.

national_raw_news.content: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of ten lakh rupees on a private company operating a ride-hailing platform for soliciting additional payments from consumers before completion of their journeys through its pre-ride ‘tip’ and ‘add-on’ feature. CCPA has directed the platform to immediately discontinue the practice, holding that it misleads consumers, constitutes an unfair trade practice and employs a dark pattern. The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution said that the order was passed by the CCPA, headed by Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare and Commissioner Anupam Mishra. The order was passed following an examination of the feature that prompted consumers to make an additional payment while the app was searching for a driver, suggesting that it could improve their chances of securing a ride faster. The Ministry said that the practice was found to be contrary to Clause 14.15 of the Motor Vehicles Aggregators Guidelines, 2025, which provides for a tipping feature only after completion of the journey. CCPA noted that the platform continued displaying the prompt even after the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways clarified earlier this year that such prompts could not be displayed before completion of the ride. The Ministry said that consumers who encounter such practices or face difficulties in accessing services can register their complaints through the National Consumer Helpline at 1 9 1 5 or write to com-ccpa@gov.in .

national_raw_news.title: Fight against TB becomes Jan Andolan, powered by community participation and patient-centric care...
national_raw_news.content: Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare Jagat Prakash Nadda today said that India’s fight against tuberculosis (TB) is showing encouraging results. The Minister said this following the release of the World Health Organization’s Global Tuberculosis Report 2026. The report highlighted a 38 per cent reduction in TB mortality since 2015, surpassing the global decline of 35 per cent, and a 94 per cent treatment success rate among patients with drug-susceptible TB. In a social media post, Mr Nadda said that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, India’s fight against TB has become a nationwide Jan Andolan, powered by technology, community participation and patient-centric care. The Minister said that over 25 crore people have been covered under intensified TB screening under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan. He also said that under the initiative more than 11 crore chest X-rays and 3 crore molecular tests have been conducted. Mr Nadda said that these efforts have led to the detection of over 48 lakh TB cases, including nearly 15 lakh asymptomatic cases, enabling early diagnosis and timely initiation of treatment. Mr Nadda further said that from AI-enabled diagnostics to nutritional support under Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana and the dedicated efforts of Ni-kshay Mitras, the Government is strengthening every aspect of TB care. He emphasized that these achievements reinforce the Government’s resolve to ensure that no TB patient is left behind. He also said that with Jan Bhagidari and the collective commitment, the Government will continue moving towards a TB-Mukt Bharat.

national_raw_news.title: PM Modi will discuss various ways to further strengthen INDIA-ASEAN ties during Manila visit: MEA
national_raw_news.content: Secretary, East, in the Ministry of External Affairs, Rudendra Tandon today released the third edition of the ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report (AIDCR) 2026, titled “Navigating Global Uncertainties and Strengthening Partnerships” in New Delhi. The report offers several practical policy suggestions to further advance cooperation between India and ASEAN member states, particularly in the areas of trade and maritime cooperation. In his address, Mr Tandon said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi will undertake a visit to Manila to attend the 23rd ASEAN – India Summit where he will discuss various ways and means to further strengthen INDIA-ASEAN ties. Mr Tandon said that in addition to India’s active bilateral relations with all eleven ASEAN member States, India also considers its engagement with the ASEAN regional platform as a key element of building block of its Act East Policy. Mr Tandon said that India has prioritised maritime domain activities in its engagement and collaboration with ASEAN. He said India has much to offer in areas such as maritime safety, security and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR), which can help the ASEAN grouping, particularly in its activities that it undertakes under its Political and Security pillar. He emphasised that stronger strategic and economic ties would enhance the capacity of both sides to navigate growing global uncertainties. Addressing the event Director general of RIS Sachin Kumar Sharma emphasised the need to translate the economic and strategic complementarities between ASEAN and India into tangible outcomes. He observed that the substantial expansion in bilateral trade had not been accompanied by comparable integration in regional production networks.

national_raw_news.title: Hockey player Lalremsiami Hmar becomes first sportperson from Mizoram to receive Arjuna award 18 mins ago 5
national_raw_news.content: Indian women’s hockey player and Olympian Lalremsiami Hmar today became the first sportsperson from Mizoram to receive the prestigious Arjuna Award, adding another milestone to her trailblazing career. The 26-year-old was among 17 sportspersons selected for the Arjuna Award 2025 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports on August 18. President Droupadi Murmu formally presented the honour to her at a ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi today. Lalremsiami, who hailed from Kolasib in the northern part of Mizoram bordering Assam, took up hockey at a young age. Her talent was spotted by teachers Lallawmawmi, Lalrampari and Lalrothuami, who encouraged her to pursue the sport. Lalremsiami joined the state-run hockey academy at Thenzawl in 2011 at the age of 11, before moving to the National Hockey Academy in New Delhi in 2016. Lalremsiami made her national debut at the Junior Nehru Hockey Tournament in October 2011 and was later selected for India’s Under-18 team for the Asian Cup in 2016. She earned her first senior national team call-up in 2017 and was part of India’s Asia Cup-winning side that year. Since then, she has established herself as a key member of the Indian team, featuring in several major international tournaments, including the Tokyo Olympics 2020, where India finished fourth. She created history in 2018 by becoming the first sportsperson from Mizoram to win an Asian Games medal, helping India secure silver. Her commitment to the national team drew widespread admiration in 2019 when she chose to remain with the squad for the FIH Women’s Series in Japan despite the death of her father, Lalthansanga Zote. India won the tournament and secured qualification for the Tokyo Olympics, making Lalremsiami the first woman from Mizoram to compete at the Olympics. She followed in the footsteps of archer C. Lalremsanga, who represented India at the 1992 Barcelona and 1996 Atlanta Olympics. In 2020, Lalremsiami became the first Indian female hockey player to win the International Hockey Federation’s Women’s Rising Star of the Year award. Her list of achievements has since grown to include a bronze at the 2022 Asian Games, Asian Champions Trophy titles in 2023 and 2024, and gold at the 2026 Asian Games. The Mizoram government had earlier announced a cash reward of Rs 40 lakh each for Lalremsiami and fellow Mizo player Lalthantluangi for their contribution to India’s women’s hockey team that won gold at the Asian Games on October 2. The Arjuna Award now adds another distinction to Lalremsiami’s career, making her the first sportsperson from Mizoram to receive one of the country’s highest honours for sporting achievement.

national_raw_news.title: NSEIX opens European markets to Indian investors via GIFT City platform 13 mins ago 4
national_raw_news.content: The NSE International Exchange (NSEIX), NSE’s global investment platform, has announced the expansion of its global investment offerings into seven key European markets through its GIFT City-based entity. The expansion increases Indian investors’ access to European-listed securities and Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). NSEIX Global Access IFSC Limited (NSEIXGA), India’s first entity registered as a Global Access Provider under the regulatory framework of the International Financial Services Centres Authority, said in a statement that the expanded investment universe includes more than 11,500 securities, including over 8,200 UCITS ETFs across the European markets, including France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. A key feature of the new offering is access to UCITS ETFs, which combine the benefits of exchange-traded investment products with an established European regulatory framework. These ETFs provide access to a wide range of global indices, markets, sectors, themes and asset classes, offering investors an alternative to investing in individual securities. UCITS ETFs also offer distinct tax advantages, further enhancing their appeal as an option for globally diversified investments. With this addition, investors will have access to a broader range of international investment products beyond the platform’s existing offerings in the US market. The expansion aims to cater to growing investor interest in international markets by providing access to a wider range of investment opportunities through a single integrated account.

national_raw_news.title: Jharkhand: National Tribal Pride March begins to mark 151st birth anniversary of Birsa Munda 3 mins ago 1
national_raw_news.content: The National Tribal Pride March was ceremonially flagged off today from Ulihatu, in Khunti district of Jharkhand, the birthplace of Bhagwan Birsa Munda, to mark his 151st birth anniversary and Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas. “The soil of Khunti district in Jharkhand, which continues to echo the immortal saga of Ulgulan, reverberated once again today with slogans of tribal pride and self-respect. The three-day National Tribal Pride March was flagged off by descendants of Bhagwan Birsa Munda. Earlier, floral tributes were paid at the statue of Dharti Aaba, and his descendants were felicitated. Former Union Minister Arjun Munda, former Chief Minister Madhu Koda and Neelkanth Singh Munda, along with several senior leaders, paid tribute to the indomitable courage and supreme sacrifice of Bhagwan Birsa Munda. The special chariot carrying the statue of Bhagwan Birsa Munda is the main attraction of the march, conveying the message of his struggle and glorious legacy to the people. On the first day, the march will cover a distance of 28 kilometres to reach Khunti. The procession, which began at Ulihatu, will culminate on the 15th of November at Bhagwan Birsa Munda’s memorial in Kokar, Ranchi, where the nation will pay its heartfelt tributes to the great tribal icon.

national_raw_news.title: J&K: Massive search operation launched in Kishtwar’s Dachhan; DGP holds high-level meeting 3 hours ago 52
national_raw_news.content: In Jammu and Kashmir, massive Cordon and Search Operations (CASOs) were launched on Thursday across the treacherous Dachchan-Marwah forests of Kishtwar and adjoining areas after the security forces recovered bullet-riddled bodies of two Special Police Officers (SPOs), who had gone missing while heading towards Dharna army post on November 11. Reports said that the service weapons of the slain SPOs remained missing. Meanwhile, the Director General of Police, Nalin Prabhat on Wednesday visited Kishtwar to take stock of the situation at the incident site and monitor intensive searches currently underway there. The DGP held a high-level meeting with the senior officers of Army and central paramilitary forces to take an assessment of the security situation and operational preparedness. The slain SPOs, identified as Rashpal Kumar, 45 and Bobby Chand, 57 were part of SOG Kiyar sector in Dachchan. They were detailed for reporting at 17 RR TOB (Temporary Operational Base) camp in Marwah sector for duty on Wednesday morning yet till late evening they did not reach there, thus triggering searches. On Thursday, their bullet-riddled bodies were recovered 2-3 kms from the site from where they reportedly went missing. Reinforced security forces, with special teams equipped with drones, other advanced technology and sniffer dogs, were engaged in CASOs in search of assassins.

national_raw_news.title: New Tractor Plant in UP’s Jewar to Generate 1,200 Direct Jobs
national_raw_news.content: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Thursday virtually laid the foundation stone for a tractor manufacturing plant in the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) area of Jewar, with the project expected to generate around 1,200 direct jobs. The state-of-the-art facility, to be set up by CNH Industrial on 100 acres in Sector 8 of the YEIDA region, involves an estimated investment of Rs 1,200 crore. Besides direct employment, the project is expected to create a significant number of indirect jobs. Speaking at the event, Adityanath said Jewar was emerging as one of India’s prominent investment destinations. With the development of the Noida International Airport and several industrial projects in the YEIDA region, the area is poised to become a major industrial, economic and logistics hub, he said. The chief minister attributed the rise in investments to improvements in the state’s law-and-order situation and the government’s zero-tolerance policy towards crime. He also credited the support of local farmers and public representatives for opening up new avenues of development in the region. Referring to the state’s enforcement measures against illegal activities, Adityanath said the bulldozer had become a “brand of Uttar Pradesh”. He added that manufacturing products such as bulldozers and tractors in the state would help meet growing demand in domestic and international markets. Under the guidance of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Uttar Pradesh has received investment proposals worth more than Rs 50 lakh crore over the past nine-and-a-half years, he said. Of these, investments worth nearly Rs 15 lakh crore have materialised, while proposals worth Rs 7.5 lakh crore are expected to reach the ground-breaking stage soon. Adityanath said Uttar Pradesh had moved beyond the category of underdeveloped states and emerged as one of the country’s three largest economies, while pursuing the target of becoming a $1 trillion economy. Highlighting the state’s industrial expansion, he said the number of factories had increased from 14,000 to 35,000, while the number of micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) had reached one crore. The number of startups had also grown from 120 to 25,000, he added. The chief minister said Uttar Pradesh had established itself in Ease of Doing Business, “Fearless Business” and “Trust of Doing Business”, and ranked first in the country in deregulation. He also highlighted several projects coming up in the Jewar and YEIDA region, including the HCL-Foxconn semiconductor plant, Medical Device Park, Toy Park, MSME Park and multiple data centre projects. The state was also creating opportunities in emerging sectors such as information technology, semiconductors, cybersecurity, robotics and agritech, Adityanath said. Through collaborations with companies including Tata, Samsung, Microsoft, IBM, Infosys and HCL, the government was providing skill development training to young people to prepare an industry-ready workforce, he added. The CNH Industrial facility is expected to provide fresh impetus to the state’s agricultural machinery and tractor manufacturing sector, the chief minister said. Uttar Pradesh accounts for around 18.5 per cent of India’s tractor market, and the project would support industrial growth while benefiting the local economy and agriculture sector, he added. national_raw_news.title: CBDT actively implements Special Campaign 6 for swachhata and administrative efficiency
national_raw_news.content: CBDT actively implements Special Campaign 6 for swachhata and administrative efficiency Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर CBDT actively implements Special Campaign 6 for swachhata and administrative efficiency ANI | Updated: Nov 13, 2026 19:14 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], November 13 (ANI): The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) achieved significant results under the Special Campaign 6. As per the release, conducted across all field formations of the Income Tax Department, the campaign focused on institutionalising Swachhata , streamlining record management and ensuring disposal of pending matters, in accordance with the guidelines of the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) and as a continuation of the successful campaigns undertaken since 2021. During Special Campaign 6, the Income Tax Department achieved remarkable progress across all key parameters. Through systematic weeding out and space optimisation initiatives, the CBDT freed up 1.54 lakh sq ft of office space and earned revenue of Rs 36.9 lakh from the sale of scrap and obsolete materials. In the area of records management, more than 90,000 physical files were weeded out, while more than 24,000 e-files were closed. Cleanliness campaigns were conducted across all Income Tax offices in India and also in various public places, reinforcing the Department’s commitment to cleanliness and sustainability. On the citizen-centric front, the CBDT disposed of 29,153 public grievances, surpassing the initial target of 15,081 cases. To promote wider public awareness of the Special Campaign, extensive outreach was carried out through social media. More than 200 tweets and posts were shared by the field formations of the Income Tax Department on their official handles, highlighting campaign milestones and local initiatives. In addition to meeting the operational targets, different regions undertook a series of unique and innovative initiatives under Special Campaign 6. Some of the noteworthy best practices implemented during the campaign are as follows: Various Income Tax Offices across India - at Bengaluru, Chennai, Gujarat, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Odisha and Delhi undertook initiatives for the proper disposal of e-waste generated in office premises, promoting environmentally responsible waste management and ensuring the systematic handling of discarded electronic items, in addition to generating revenue to the tune of Rs 17,66,225. The freed-up area is now available for multipurpose official use, including better space allocation and storage arrangements. This initiative has reduced clutter, improved cleanliness and hygiene, enhanced workplace organisation and enabled more efficient utilisation of departmental infrastructure. The exercise also promotes environmentally responsible e-waste management and contributes to a cleaner, safer and more functional working environment. Gaj-Garuda Symbolic Structure: The office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Bhubaneswar, Odisha organised a ‘Waste to Art’ exhibition. A symbolic structure titled Gaj-Garuda, depicting the mythical Garuda holding an elephant by its trunk, was installed by the Pr. CCIT, Odisha region. The structure was built at zero cost, using office scrap like broken steel grills, discarded plastic paint containers, single-use plastic water bottles, and broken pieces of plastic water coolers. The initiative beautifully aligns with the "Waste to Art" mission...

national_raw_news.title: Centre merges Central Bureau of Communication and Press Information Bureau | MorungExpress
national_raw_news.content: Centre merges Central Bureau of Communication and Press Information Bureau | MorungExpress | morungexpress.com Centre merges Central Bureau of Communication and Press Information Bureau Centre merges Central Bureau of Communication and Press Information Bureau (Photo: @PIBRaipur/X) India 13th November 2026 New Delhi, November 13 (IANS): In a major development, the Union government has announced the merger of the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) and the Press Information Bureau (PIB) at the headquarters level. In an attempt that appears aimed at an administrative overhaul and to create a unified public outreach mechanism, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) has brought about an integration of the government’s flagship advertising and publicity agency and the primary media relations arm. The unified organisation will be called PIB, according to the ministry. The strategic consolidation is expected to eliminate functional overlaps, optimise resource allocation, and deliver efficient messaging on government policies, welfare schemes, and national initiatives, said ministry sources. The combined entity will be headed by the Director-General (Coordination), PIB, New Delhi, who will report to the Chairman/Communication Board, they added. All the state- and branch-level organisations will also be replicated. By combining the CBC’s extensive advertising and overall outreach infrastructure with PIB’s daily information and press dissemination capabilities, the MIB intends to establish a faster, more responsive, and integrated communication ecosystem. The CBC is a unit of the MIB and has the mandate of providing all-round communication solutions to ministries, related departments, Public Sector Undertakings, and autonomous bodies. It was set up on December 8, 2017, with the integration of the erstwhile Directorate of Advertising and Visual Publicity (DAVP), Directorate of Field Publicity (DFP), and Song and Drama Division (S&DD). This change was made with the purpose of maintaining uniformity and streamlining the vocabulary of the state and central divisions, according to ministry officials at that time. CBC undertakes various campaigns towards sharing government policies and programmes to evoke people’s participation in developmental activities using various communication platforms, like print media advertising, audio-visual campaigns, dissemination through exhibitions, outdoor campaigns, digital media, among others. Meanwhile, PIB is the government’s nodal agency to disseminate information to the print and electronic media in several languages on government policies, programmes, initiatives and achievements. It functions as an interface between the government and media and serves to provide feedback to the government on the people’s reaction as reflected in the media. PIB’s history can be traced back to the First World War, making it a century-old organisation. national_raw_news.content: Ministry Of Information And Broadcasting: MIB Unifies PIB and CBC into New Integrated Structure, ETBrandEquity Media 1 min read MIB brings PIB, CBC under one unified organisational structure The restructuring brings the Central Bureau of Communication under the Press Information Bureau, with the Director General (Coordination), PIB, set to head the combined organisation with immediate effect. BE Staff ETBrandEquity Published On Nov 13, 2026 at 05:57 PM IST Set ETBrandEquity as your preferred source on Google Copy Link Share on WhatsApp Share on Linkedin Share on X Share on Telegram Share on Facebook Highlights PIB and CBC to merge into a single unified organisation. The new PIB will report to the Chairman/Communication Board. Integration to be phased across state and branch-level offices. MIB brings PIB, CBC under one unified organisational structure The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) has ordered the functional integration of the Press Information Bureau (PIB) and the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) into a unified organisation to be called the Press Information Bureau (PIB). According to an office memorandum issued by the ministry on November 12, 2026, the combined organisation will be headed by the Director General (Coordination), PIB, New Delhi, who will report to the Chairman/Communication Board. As part of the restructuring, the office of the CBC at headquarters will be integrated with the PIB. All Additional Director General (ADG)-level Indian Information Service (IIS) officers from both organisations will report to the DG (Coordination), PIB. Advt Communication and Media Coordinators (CMCs) posted in ministries and departments in Delhi will also report to the DG (Coordination), PIB. The ministry has further stated that the integration process will be extended to state and branch-level offices in a phased manner. The organisational structure outlined in the memorandum distributes responsibilities across several functional verticals under the ADGs. These include billing and administration; advertising and publicity across audio-visual, outdoor and new media platforms; outreach programmes, exhibitions and events; and print advertisements, printing and distribution of booklets and catalogues, along with media rates. Other verticals will oversee research, New India Samachar, press tours and Vartalap, while a separate unit will handle fact-checking, social media, liaison with television channels and newspapers, and press facilitation. The CMCs in ministries and departments will be responsible for 360-degree media planning, including press releases and press briefings. State-level CMCs will coordinate all media verticals at the state level. The memorandum, signed by Under Secretary Deepak Negi, states that the decision has the approval of the competent authority and will come into effect immediately. The move covers eligible Oppanol B and Glissopal products, using renewable power at its sites and added volumes under a mass-balance chain-of-custody approach. BASF is shifting its eligible polyisobutene (PIB) portfolio produced in Europe for external customers to run entirely on renewable electricity. The full transition of eligible Oppanol B and Glissopal to 100 percent renewable electricity will be completed from January 2027. This can be achieved by combining renewable power already used at BASF’s sites with additional volumes attributed through a mass-balance chain-of-custody approach. In Ludwigshafen and Antwerp, this includes power from the Hollandse Kust Zuid offshore wind farm, co-owened by BASF, and long-term power purchase agreements. This contributes to BASF’s sustainability target of sourcing more than 60 percent of its electricity from renewable sources by 2030. BASF will shift its eligible European polyisobutene portfolio for external customers to 100 per cent renewable electricity from January 2027. The move covers eligible Oppanol B and Glissopal products, using renewable power at its sites and added volumes under a mass-balance chain-of-custody approach. No requalification is required, and sales articles remain unchanged. Further reducing the carbon footprint Renewable electricity will become the new standard for eligible European PIB products and the transition will be seamless: no product requalification is required, and existing sales articles will remain unchanged. In addition, BASF offers Glissopal and Oppanol B grades with a 100 percent cradle-to-gate Product Carbon Footprint reduction (“ZeroPCF” products). This provides customers with additional options to reduce the Product Carbon Footprint of their products, depending on product composition and the PCF methodology applied. “With Oppanol and Glissopal, we combine innovative applications with the performance, quality and reliability our customers know and trust,” said Sabrina Platzek, Senior Vice President Fuel and Lubricant Solutions at BASF . “By lowering the carbon footprint of Oppanol B and Glissopal, we are taking another concrete step to support our customers in achieving their sustainability ambitions. ” Customers use PIB products in a wide range of applications, from fuels and lubricants to the production of products such as chewing gum, window seals, stretch films, adhesives, automotive sealants, pipelines and electronics. Director The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, on Wednesday approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at the historic North and South Block complex in New Delhi, at an estimated cost of Rs 3,230 crore. The project, appraised by the Public Investment Board (PIB), aims to establish a landmark civilisational museum showcasing India’s cultural heritage, diversity and historical continuity through an integrated presentation of its tangible and intangible heritage. The museum will be developed by adaptively reusing the historic North and South Block buildings, preserving their architectural character and heritage significance while transforming them into a major public cultural institution.The project will be implemented in phases between the financial years 2026-27 and 2030-31.
